name: Name Your Price for WooCommerce – Pay What You Want & Custom Pricing
author: add-ons.org

sections.description:
DEMO: https://demo.add-ons.org/woocommerce-pdf-vouchers/product/pay-your-price/
DOCUMENT: https://add-ons.org/document-price-your-name-for-woocommerce/

Name Your Price for WooCommerce lets customers enter the price they want to pay for your products.

Perfect for donations, fundraising campaigns, tips, gift cards, digital downloads, and flexible pricing strategies, the plugin gives you complete control with optional minimum, maximum, and suggested prices.

Create engaging shopping experiences while increasing customer participation and conversions without writing a single line of code.

Why Choose Name Your Price for WooCommerce?

  • Customer-defined pricing
  • Pay What You Want products
  • Suggested price support
  • Minimum and maximum price limits
  • Donation and fundraising ready
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • No coding required

Key Features

Customer Defined Pricing

Allow customers to enter the amount they want to pay.

Suggested Price

Display a recommended price while still allowing custom amounts.

Minimum & Maximum Price

Prevent customers from entering prices outside your preferred range.

Donation Products

Perfect for charities, nonprofits, churches, and fundraising campaigns.

Variable Product Support

Supports simple, variable, downloadable, and virtual products.

Flexible Pricing Strategy

Experiment with Pay What You Want campaigns to improve conversions.

WooCommerce Integration

Works seamlessly with WooCommerce checkout and order management.

Customizable Interface

Easily adjust the input fields and messages to match your store’s design.

Discount Strategy Support

Create unique promotional campaigns by letting customers feel empowered to decide the price.

Detailed Reporting

Track and analyze customer behavior to optimize your pricing strategy.
sections.installation:
Normal installation

  1. Download the woocommerce.zip file to your computer.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Upload the plugin.zip directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
    Document include in plugin
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes. The plugin supports simple, variable, virtual, and downloadable WooCommerce products.

Can I set minimum and maximum prices?

Yes. You can define optional minimum and maximum price limits.

Can I use it for donations?

Absolutely. The plugin is perfect for donation and fundraising campaigns.

Can I display a suggested price?

Yes. Customers can see a suggested price while still entering their own amount.

Does it work with WooCommerce checkout?

Yes. The custom price is fully integrated into the WooCommerce checkout process.
